result.summary: SPC-01/SPC-02 test design validated (WF-02 Batch B Step 03b). All acceptance criteria have implemented integration tests: SPC-01 AC1..AC6 + empty-inputs and output-schema-violation edges, and SPC-02 AC1..AC2 (10/10 integration cases in tests/integration/spc01_sub_process_interface_test.zig; spec case count == implemented test count). No deferred/skipped coverage: the only error.SkipZigTest is an unreachable branch in testDbUrl() because TestHarness.init() fails loudly with MissingTestDatabaseUrl when BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent (empirically confirmed fail-loudly, not silent skip). Fixtures isolated: per-test CSPRNG UUID-derived definition names, unconditional defer cleanupByName/cleanupInstance, rollback-on-deinit harness, parameterised SQL, no hardcoded creds/URLs. Self-sufficient: real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL, real DefinitionStore/InstanceStore/engine, no mocks. Wiring verified: spc01_integration_tests addTest root, run step attached to test-integration-spc01 and test_integration_others_step, reachable from tests/integration/main_test.zig, lint_test_wiring.py PASS (exit 0). Bonus: executed `zig build test-integration-spc01` against real Postgres (port 5434) and all 10/10 integration tests passed.

issues.description: tests/specs/SPC-01.md 'Runnable file mapping' lists test names (e.g. sub_process_declared_inputs_are_filtered_test) that do not match the actual test block names in tests/integration/spc01_sub_process_interface_test.zig (which use descriptive 'SPC-01 AC1: ...' titles). Case count and AC coverage map 1:1, but the mapping text is inaccurate for traceability.

testDbUrl() in tests/integration/spc01_sub_process_interface_test.zig returns error.SkipZigTest on missing BPM_TEST_DB_URL, but this branch is unreachable because TestHarness.init() (called first in every test) fails loudly with MissingTestDatabaseUrl. Dead-code/latent-trap; matches repo convention (ext05 uses same pattern) but worth cleaning up.

No e2e pipeline file under web/tests/e2e/pipelines/ references SPC-01/SPC-02. Not blocking: SPC-01/SPC-02 are SHOULD (not MUST) backend requirements, so pipeline criterion (6) does not trigger; noted for ORCH/TEST-RUNNER visibility regarding the SUB_PROCESS interface editor UI delivered in Step 02b.
